prediction: mean softmax over 20 dropout passes, T = 1
uncertainty: per image: total_entropy = H[mean softmax]; expected_entropy = mean of the samples' entropies (aleatoric); mutual_info = total - expected (epistemic, the disagreement score, D13); variance = variance across samples of each class probability, mean over classes. Fourth score: neg_mutual_info.

threshold.chosen_on: degraded validation images (every corruption x severity)
limits: PlantVillage laboratory images: one detached leaf on a plain background, not field photographs
four classes (black rot, esca, leaf blight, healthy); any other disease or crop is out of scope

only the four synthetic corruptions (Gaussian blur, brightening, darkening, square occlusion) at severities 1-5; background clutter, other cameras, motion blur and several leaves in one image are untested
one trained model (one seed); another training run can move the threshold
a condition where the threshold accepts nothing meets the target only vacuously: everything there is referred to a human
